name: 7 ELEMENTS COFFEE ROASTERS
about_blurb: We source 100% organic beans from coffee farms around India, and roast them in micro batches using state of the art roasting equipment. Through a network of retail partners, we sell 100% Arabica specialty coffee beans, blends of Arabica and Robusta in variety of packs and form – Whole beans, Custom Ground Coffee, Hot Drip Bags, and Cold Brew Bags. 7 Elements Coffee Roasters, is a specialty artisan coffee roaster and retailer based in Pune, India. The company was founded in 2022 by two coffee enthusiasts who shared a passion for sourcing and roasting high-quality coffee beans. We typically, roast our coffee beans to order, which means that the coffee is always fresh

name: 7000 Steps - India's Most Remote Coffee
tagline: Extraordinary coffee from the heart of Northeast India.
about_blurb: 7000 Steps is a specialty coffee company sourcing exclusively from the Seven Sister States of Northeast India, working directly with over 200 farming families across Meghalaya, Assam, and beyond. Their small, hands-on team pairs artisan roasting expertise with deep farmer relationships to bring rare microlot coffees from remote highland microclimates to customers nationwide. Every bag traces back to a specific community, making each cup a journey into India's most unexplored coffee frontier.

name: 729 Grams Coffee Roasters
tagline: Buy freshly roasted specialty coffee and high scoring coffee at 729 grams coffee roasters in Koregaon park, Pune.
about_blurb: 729 Grams Coffee Roasters is a Pune-based specialty coffee roasting startup founded in 2022, offering meticulously sourced beans from the finest coffee estates in India and across the globe. Operating out of Koregaon Park, the roastery pairs its specialty coffee program with a European bakehouse experience, and offers Specialty Coffee Association-certified training for baristas and enthusiasts alike. Every bean is chosen to showcase the rich diversity of flavors and profiles that different origins have to offer.

name: 93 Degrees Coffee Roasters
about_blurb: To enrich the Indian coffee drinking experience and promote sustainable and ethical practices that make it special, one cup at a time 93˚ Coffee Roasters was established with the aim of taking coffee to unmapped territories. We give value to calculated risk taking and delivering products that bring a change. Our vision stems from our love for coffee. Travelling the world, meeting new people and learning their stories made us decide that it was time to revolutionise India’s coffee culture. Rather than simply looking forward to the next travel itinerary in search of the perfect cup, we are determined to bring the experience home; to hold, sip, and enjoy. Back in the 16th Century, A sufi saint named Baba Budan decided to take matters into his own hands and go on a pilgrimage to Yemen and smuggled back seeds of coffee to India. He then planted these in Chikmagalur, a region in the state of Karnataka in India. Through great fortune, the seven seeds prospered into a flourishing coffee plantation across the southern part of the country. Thereafter, began the many stories and experiences shared with friends, family and colleagues over a cup of coffee.

name: ARAKU Coffee
tagline: India's first coffee to shape the complete seed-to-cup journey.
about_blurb: ARAKU Coffee is India's pioneering seed-to-cup specialty brand, sourcing 100% Arabica from the world's largest certified organic plantation in the Araku Valley of the Eastern Ghats, Andhra Pradesh. Built on 'Arakunomics,' their equitable farmer model — endorsed by The Rockefeller Foundation's Food System Vision 2050 Prize — eliminates middlemen and ensures tribal farming communities share in the value chain. With flagship stores in Paris and Bangalore and cupping scores of 91 points, ARAKU has placed Indian specialty coffee on the global map.

name: Agastya Coffee Cafe & Store, Madikeri
tagline: Shade-grown, bird-friendly single-origin coffee from Coorg.
about_blurb: Agastya Coffee is a women-led specialty coffee enterprise based in Madikeri, Coorg, celebrating the dedication of small farms on Coorg's lush hill slopes by blending age-old traditions with the modern advantage of direct trade. Their single-origin coffees are shade-grown, selectively hand-picked, and bird-friendly, sourced in partnership with small farms across Kodagu. Beyond roasting, Agastya runs an all-day café and coffee tasting experience center in Madikeri, making them a destination for both locals and visitors.

name: Ainmane Café & Speciality Store
about_blurb: With love from the highlands of Coorg, We bring to you our legacy of flavours. Coorg has a rich and vibrant culture that is unique and fascinating. Of the many things typically Coorg, its cuisine plays a crucial part in reminding us of its glorious heritage. At AinMané, we aim to carry this legacy forward by bringing to you the best collection of food products from the highlands of Coorg & Western Ghats. Through significant collaboration with like-minded coffee growers, beekeepers and other agriculturists, we have made sure that each and every product is 100% genuine, like they have always been in the homes of Coorg.

name: Aromas of Coorg
tagline: Buy freshly roasted coffee beans sourced from the finest Estates in Coorg. Choose an authentic Indian filter Coffee Powder. Free shipping.
about_blurb: We produce Robusta and Arabica beans, grown at 900 – 1100 meters above sea level, handpicked and sorted. We’re kind of outdoorsy in our approach, because to produce the right beans, you have to tromp through some pretty rugged interior locations of Coffee growing regions. We also source from the best of coffee Estates across India. Our sourcing and selection team maintains stringent standards when selecting green coffee for our menu. All beans, from the components of our house selection to our rotating cast of signature coffees, go through our intense quality processes to meet our high standards. Our quality protocols require cupping (tasting) hundreds of samples of coffee per year, maintaining a seasonal rotation of beans. We leave no stone unturned to ensure you get the best coffee at home or at work. Our endeavour is to become the best personalised coffee brand. What we do isn’t just cultivation and manufacturing, it’s an Art….Every step of the way, from coffee cherry to your cup, is managed to fit our exacting standards.

name: Bake n shake

name: Beachville Coffee Roasters
tagline: Make Every Coffee Special.
about_blurb: Beachville Coffee Roasters is an Indian specialty roaster focused on estate-driven, single-origin coffees that highlight the natural terroir of South Indian growing regions. Their lineup spans carefully curated nano-lots — including limited fermented naturals from Kerehaklu Estate — through to espresso and filter blends sourced from estates in Chikmaglur and Yercaud. Roasts range from light to medium-dark, tailored to showcase the fruit, chocolate, and caramel notes inherent to each origin.

name: Black Fuel Roastery
tagline: Black Fuel Roastery – small-batch specialty coffee sourced from India’s small farms. Micro-lots, espresso blends, and curated coffee subscriptions.
about_blurb: Black Fuel Roastery is a specialty micro-roastery and café nestled in Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad, born from a commitment to sourcing rare microlots from tribal farms that preserve ancient growing practices. Each lot of green beans is carefully cupped and roast-profiled to highlight the unique characteristics of its origin, with a primary focus on Araku Valley and South Indian specialty estates. Set in their co-founder's backyard, they serve only what they themselves savour, creating an honest and personal coffee experience.

name: Bloom Coffee Roasters - Head Office
tagline: Delicious speciality coffee, from India's finest coffee estates, roasted in small batches with love and care! Free shipping for all coffees across India!
about_blurb:
Coffee is much more than just a super drink that wakes you up and enables you to function well throughout the day! So what exactly is Coffee? Is it that weird soluble powder that comes in a jar as instant coffee? NO! Well coffee is many things, at different times! To begin with, Coffee is a plant, which produces a fruit called, you guessed it, Coffee! That fruit looks very much like a Cherry, and is in fact called a coffee cherry! Once that cherry is bright red and ripe, it is picked manually and is sent further for processing! 

What is processing now? Well quite simply processing is the process of removing the seed from the Cherry! To know more about Processing, check out our blog! Once that seed is removed from the Cherry, that green seed is what is called “Green Coffee” which is sorted for defects, graded, bagged in hermetic grain bags and then romantic looking jute bags and shipped off to us - Coffee Roasters! The green coffee seeds are then carefully roasted by us to set profiles to make sure we make that coffee (green coffee) taste as good as it can. Our approach to roasting relies a lot on what that coffee wants to be and how it wants to taste best! That roasted “Coffee Bean” is then bagged (sometimes ground) and sent to you, the consumer to brew a delicious cup of “Coffee”

name: Bombay Island Coffee Company | Vikhroli
about_blurb: Bombay Island Coffee Company is an artisanal Coffee Company  born out of boundless passionfor coffee founded by Rupal Jain with a mission to provide high quality coffee to all coffee lovers across the globe through our cafes and online supplies.  We are part by the Third Wave Coffee Movement which has redefined the ideas around sourcing, roasting & brewing coffee. We source the finest quality coffee beans and custom roast them on our beautiful roaster especially for you. Our coffees are proudly grown in India reflecting our tradition, nature andthe story of our culture. We source coffees from award winning estates of chikmagalur, karnataka. We roast our coffees in small batches in our micro-roaster probat. Our craft roasted coffee will indulge you in the essence of Indian soil, so that you can enjoy the aromatic experience of the Indian beans with each sip. Carving the niche of every individual, we recreate the ideal bean to cup stories, leaving a sense of cultural mystery in the air. We are dedicated to provide you a unique & enriching experiencein your cup of black gold that satisfies your soul. In the entire journey from crop to cup we believe in maintaining keen focus on standards & excellence. Our methods for selection of green beans and technology for roasting them makes our coffee one of its kind. We follow the standards set by specialty coffee association in every stage of coffee making.

name: Brew Culture Viman Nagar
about_blurb: Brew Culture is a premium coffee chain with multiple locations in Pune, India. Our goal is to provide coffee enthusiasts with a unique and memorable coffee experience that is unmatched by other coffee shops. We use only the finest coffee beans from the world's best coffee-growing regions, and offer a wide selection of brewing methods to suit every taste preference. Our baristas are knowledgeable and passionate about coffee, and are dedicated to crafting the perfect cup for every customer. At Brew Culture, we offer a wide selection of brewing methods, including espresso, latte, and iced coffee, so that everyone can enjoy their preferred type of coffee. name: COPPER & CRUMB & PATISSERIE , PANCHKULA
tagline: Where French technique meets Indian heart, crafting tomorrow's classics today
about_blurb: Copper & Crumb is an artisanal patisserie and café in Panchkula that grew from kitchen experiments during motherhood into a full-scale culinary destination. The brand blends antique copper aesthetics with modern espresso machines, pairing Kerala vanilla beans and French butter to create a distinctly Indo-French experience. Alongside their award-worthy cakes, desserts, and cookies, they serve house-roasted specialty coffee in an exhibition kitchen setting.

name: Caarabi Coffee Roasters
tagline: Fresh Roasted Coffee to perfection, just for you!
about_blurb: Caarabi Coffee Roasters — whose name is an anagram of 'Arabica' — was founded with a singular purpose: to roast coffee that is genuinely satisfying to drink, staying true to the soul of each bean through equitable and sustainable farm partnerships. Their catalog spans Global Drops, Microlots, Nanolots, and a Dark Roast Series, with Indian estate partners including Ratnagiri Estate and Melkodige Estate in Chandragiri. The roastery champions traceability and craft, believing nothing is more important than the pursuit of a great cup.

name: Cafe De Meet

flavours to accentuate your taste buds! Caffeination Roasteralso famous as theCAFE DE MEETis a passion-driven brand based in Surat, India that specializes in sourcing and roasting the finest Arabica coffee beans. tagline: Now enjoy your favourite authentic tea anywhere, anytime.

name: Cafe Tea Trunk
about_blurb: At Tea Trunk, we not only love curating unique blends, but also the best of tea experiences. Enter into our beautiful Tea room, housed in an iconic Heritage Home in Fontainhas, more than 100 years old. name: Candour Coffee Roastery
tagline: Indian Specialty Coffee Roasters.
about_blurb: Candour Coffee Roastery is an Indian luxury specialty coffee brand built on honesty, heritage, and an obsession with craft, positioning itself as a roaster of high-altitude Arabica sourced and roasted in microlots with precision. Their product range spans Easy Pour Kits in light, medium, and medium-dark roasts, whole bean offerings, and cold brew kits, catering to both home brewers and specialty enthusiasts. name: Chika - A Coffee Collective
about_blurb: "Chika" has been derived from the word Chikkamagaluru- the homeland of Indian shade-grown Coffee. We at Chika Coffee Collective, serve as a platform for collaboration, knowledge exchange, and the celebration of Indian coffee culture. At Chika Coffee Collective, we are passionate about bringing you the finest Indian specialty coffees. With a focus on sustainability, quality, and the unique flavors of India, we aim to provide an exceptional coffee experience that will delight your senses.

name: Coffee Crown Homestay
about_blurb: Nestled in the heart of a lush coffee estate, Coffee Crown Homestay offers a peaceful retreat with private rooms, delicious buffet home food, and a cozy campfire experience. Just 1KM from a beautiful waterfall, it’s the perfect getaway for nature lovers. Enjoy the fresh air, scenic views, and warm hospitality.. With a Generous Heart of Hospitality, we provide the whole Villa, with comfortable & luxurious Rooms – making you right at Home! Indulge thyself amidst the Solitude of the Mountains, Breathing Fresh Meditative Air of the Mountains, far away from Civilization…

name: Coffee Culture
tagline: India's Finest Specialty Coffee Roastery.
about_blurb: Coffee Culture India is a specialty coffee roastery offering a curated selection of single-origin and microlot coffees sourced from renowned Indian estates. Their catalogue highlights precision-processed coffees including light roast and medium-light roast microlots from estates such as Attikan and Baarbara. They position themselves as India's finest specialty coffee roastery, catering to discerning home brewers and café professionals.

name: Coffee Culture Reserve
tagline: India's Finest Specialty Coffee Roastery.
about_blurb: Coffee Culture Reserve is the premium microlot arm of Coffee Culture India, focusing on rare and experimental processing methods such as mixed fruit fermentation and culture process coffees. Sourcing from select Indian estates, the Reserve range targets specialty coffee enthusiasts seeking complex, traceable, and limited-release offerings. Their meticulous approach to fermentation and roast profiling sets them apart in the Indian specialty market.

name: Coffee Sutra C-Scheme
tagline: Coffee Sutra is a tribe that connects stories and storytellers. Serving cups of sustainable wholesomeness. Natural goodness at best prices online. Order now!

Coffee Sutra threads together beans from the world's award winning farms. On their way to you, these beans mingle with our planter, roaster and baristas. Embrace this artisanal blend to unravel a real conversation and a real connection. With Every Cup, wakeup inclusivity. The word Sutra, derived from Sanskrit, means “thread” or “connection”—a beautiful representation of what coffee means to us: bringing people together, weaving stories, and building a community.

name: Coffeeverse Experience Centre
about_blurb: Coffeeverse is a coffee roasting and brewing company, sourcing beans from the finest estates. We are bold, knowledgeable, and modern, blending education with lifestyle. Coffeeverse is not an attempt to make specialty coffee “cooler” or “hip”, it is only a representation of the coffee community and their lifestyle choices. For us Coffee isn’t just a product—it’s a culture, a craft, and a statement.Coffeeverse is the ultimate destination for all things coffee, crafted to bring the universe of speciality coffee right to your fingertips. With each pack of coffee that we ship, our goal is to provide a transparent farm to cup journey.  Dive into an extraordinary coffee adventure with our handpicked selection of Coffeeverse's premium beans! Plus, discover top-notch brewing equipment that meet international standards, crafted for everyone from curious newcomers to seasoned connoisseurs, making it perfect for elevating your own coffee experience. Our coffee journey starts in the lush hills of Chikmagalur, Karnataka, and stretches all the way to the Nilgiris in Tamil Nadu. Along the way, we work with some of the best coffee farms and passionate farmers who pour their heart into every lot they process. It’s the journey that keeps us focused and reminds us to always respect the hard work behind every coffee bean.

name: CoorgExpress
tagline: Coffee Products
about_blurb: Curating micro and nano lots from the small and medium coffee growers of Kodagu, inspired by the landscapes and biodiversity of the Western Ghats. Through CoorgExpress and the Kaapi Trails initiative, we connect coffee drinkers with the farmers, forests, and traditions that shape Coorg coffee. CoorgExpress is a coffee brand built around the small and medium coffee growers of Kodagu (Coorg), one of India’s most important coffee-producing regions known for its distinctive shade-grown coffees of the Western Ghats.

name: Corridor Seven Coffee Roasters
tagline: India's finest single-estate coffees, roasted fresh twice a week.
about_blurb: Corridor Seven Coffee Roasters is an Indian specialty roaster dedicated entirely to single-estate Indian coffees, sourcing from renowned estates such as Kuchally, Salawara, Gungegiri, Basankhan, Attikan, Melkodige, and Riverdale. Their lineup showcases advanced processing methods including bioreactor naturals, carbonic maceration, and saccharomyces fermentation, alongside accessible blends like BR!M and Cold Brew BOLD. Roasting freshly every Monday and Thursday, they bring a rigorous farm-to-cup philosophy to the Indian specialty coffee scene.

name: Corridor Seven Coffee Roastery/Standing Room
about_blurb: Corridor Seven Coffee Roasters is an Indian specialty roastery known for its rigorous sourcing from named Indian estates and a strong emphasis on experimental processing — including natural fermentation, carbonic maceration, and bioreactor naturals. They roast on a structured schedule (Mondays and Thursdays) and offer an extensive grind-to-order service across all major brew methods. Their Standing Room café concept brings their roastery-direct coffees to an accessible retail experience.

name: Corridor Seven Lean
about_blurb: Corridor Seven Lean is a signature blend from Corridor Seven Coffee Roasters, designed as an approachable and consistent everyday offering within their specialty lineup. Part of Corridor Seven's range of house blends alongside BR!M and Cold Brew Bold, the LEAN Blend delivers a refined cup tailored for espresso and filter brewing. It reflects the roastery's commitment to traceable Indian-estate sourcing paired with precise roasting schedules.

name: Cothas Coffee - Chikkamagaluru (Karnataka)
tagline: The coffee a new nation woke up to.
about_blurb: Cothas Coffee Co. is a Bengaluru-based heritage coffee brand founded in 1949 by Sri Krishnaiah Chetty, now managed by its third generation. Renowned for its traditional South Indian filter coffee, the company sources premium beans from the hills of Kodagu and Chikkamagaluru in Karnataka and roasts them using German machinery and proprietary techniques in a 40,000 sq. ft. ISO and FDA certified facility. From neighbourhood retailer to national brand, Cothas remains a beloved institution for authentic filter coffee culture.

name: Devan's South Indian Coffee and Tea pvt ltd
tagline: Striving to provide the world's finest coffee.
about_blurb: Devan's South Indian Coffee and Tea, established in 1962, is one of India's most storied specialty roasters and is recognised as North India's first dedicated coffee roastery. Renowned for sourcing and expertly roasting the finest single-origin Indian coffees — including Monsooned Malabar, Mysore Nuggets Extra Bold, and Robusta Kaapi Royale — as well as crafting customised blends for nearly six decades. Devan's serves a loyal community of filter coffee connoisseurs, luxury resorts, and retail chains from their flagship store in Lodhi Colony, New Delhi.

name: Dope Coffee Roasters
tagline: Life's too short for bad coffee.
about_blurb: Dope Coffee Roasters is an Indian specialty coffee brand built around a culture-forward identity, roasting fresh daily and sourcing directly from named Indian plantations including Nilgiri and Kalledevarapura estates. They champion full transparency in their supply chain, publicly crediting every farm on their menu to foster direct producer-consumer connections. Beyond the cup, Dope integrates coffee into music festivals and lifestyle events, making specialty coffee accessible and exciting for a new generation.

name: Drum Coffee Roasters
tagline: Coffee built for consistency.
about_blurb: Drum Coffee Roasters is an Indian roastery built around the principle of consistency, roasting in small batches with strict quality controls to ensure every brew performs reliably across busy cafés, offices, and home setups. They work closely with farmers and offer roasting, packing, and fulfillment support for coffee businesses alongside direct roastery visits. Their Full City Roast — delivering smooth chocolate notes and a mellow finish — stands as their best-selling expression.

name: Forest Farmer Coffee Roasters
tagline: FOREST FARMER COFFEE ROASTERS
about_blurb: Forest Farmer Coffee Roasters specializes in limited-harvest, estate-grown Indian coffees roasted in small batches to order for peak freshness. They source directly from farms including Ratnagiri Estate and St. Margaret Estate in Chikmagalur, Karnataka, with a strong emphasis on fermentation stories, transparent supply chains, and Q-Grader approved selections. Their roasting philosophy is built around clarity — letting the intrinsic character of each lot shine through.

name: G-Shot Coffee Roastery & Cafe
tagline: Meditation in a cup
about_blurb: G-Shot Coffee Roastery & Cafe is a Goa-based specialty roastery founded in 2018 as a daring experiment in conscious living, roasting fresh coffee with a focus on quality, transparency, and meditative craftsmanship. They source from fine Indian estates like Narangani as well as international origins, pairing their coffee program with organic nut butters and mindfulness-oriented offerings. The brand's Kwatz retail extension embodies their philosophy of love, meditation, and meticulous craft.

name: GB Roasters
tagline: Discover the rich aroma and flavor of GB Roasters' specialty roasted coffee, handcrafted with a commitment to transparency and education. New arrivals now available!

Anup's coffee roasting adventure began in the humble confines of his garage-turned-micro-roastery in Jakarta, Indonesia. His initiation into coffee roasting was as organic as the beans he cherishes. An adventurous spirit, Anup is not just about coffee; he's also an avid motorcycle builder and trekker, indulging in these pursuits when he's not immersed in his primary passion for coffee. His love for the bean extends beyond just roasting; he's truly a coffee aficionado at heart. When not engulfed by the aroma of roasting coffee, Anup can be found either revving up his custom-built motorcycle or traversing scenic trails, pursuits that resonate with his zeal for life and love for coffee.Anup's journey hasn't always been about coffee. With a solid 15 years in the corporate world, focusing on strategy management and direct private equity, he's now fully embraced his entrepreneurial spirit, now dedicating his efforts full-time to the coffee and gastronomy. His connection with coffee farmers in Indonesia and India has brought him immense pleasure and fulfilment. Anup dedicates his time to continual education on coffee, aiming to enhance the quality of coffee in significant, albeit small, ways. tagline: Roasted Indian Specialty Coffee. Harvested in India, Roasted in Pune. Grey Soul Coffee Roasters.
about_blurb: Grey Soul Coffee Roasters is an Indian specialty coffee brand founded by Chirag in 2021, born out of a deep passion for coffee and shaped by the philosophy that the world holds infinite complexity beyond black and white. They source directly from Karnataka, Coorg, Kerala, and Nagaland, and are known for experimental roasting techniques, Q Grader certification, and a commitment to full supply chain transparency. Their Mumbai Noshery in Bandra West offers a curated specialty coffee experience alongside their vibrant café program.

name: Grey Soul Coffee Roasters (Koregaon Park)
tagline: Roasted Indian Specialty Coffee. Harvested in India, Roasted in Pune. Grey Soul Coffee Roasters.
about_blurb: Grey Soul Coffee Roasters is an Indian specialty coffee brand founded by Chirag in 2021, born out of a deep passion for coffee and shaped by the philosophy that the world holds infinite complexity beyond black and white. name: Half Light Coffee Roasters | C Scheme
tagline: Farm to Cup
about_blurb: Half Light Coffee Roasters is a Jaipur-based specialty roastery that sources single-origin Indian Arabica directly from farmers in Karnataka and Tamil Nadu, bringing farm-fresh beans straight to the cup. Founded with the belief that great coffee begins at origin, they operate a neighbourhood roastery-café with an open espresso bar designed to educate and connect customers with the craft. Their name reflects their vision of new beginnings found in the light between darkness and dawn.

name: Handcrafted Cafe Roastery and Pizzeria
tagline: Explore & Order the Best Specialty Coffee at Handcrafted - Cafe & Roastery. Ethically Sourced & Prefectly Roasted for your taste!
about_blurb: Handcrafted was born out of a desperate need for coffee shops serving good specialty coffee and create a difference in this market filled with low grade commercial coffees. We decided to have our own micro roastery and serve our customers with fresh, in-house roasted coffee beans. Our beans go through a tedious process of roast profiling and cupping giving each lot an individual profile and roast level that highlights it's own specific flavour notes and nuances. We are really proud of the reception we have received, especially after opening a store in a majorly tea drinking state like Madhya Pradesh. Introducing specialty grade coffee in Bhopal was a challenge but something we got a lot of love for. We work closely with coffee plantations, procuring coffee from the finest estates across the country. These estates work extremely hard to produce a specialty batch while making sure of sustainable and ethical practices. Coffee is more than just a drink to us, it's a practice, an art that we put a lot of care into. An entire army of people work throughout a long supply chain that brings us our daily cup of joe! It's important that we do justice to their hard work by brewing it right!

name: Home Blend Coffee Roasters | GK 2

Feeling discontent with how casually terms like artisanal or specialty were thrown around without reason, the duo studied the coffee market in India and decided to deliver truly *Specialty Grade* coffee at people’s doorstep! Today, Home Blend offers its customers with the most exotic selection of specialty coffee beans from India and Indonesia such as the famous Mysore Nuggets Extra Bold that come from the highest peaks of Baba Budan region (The place that marks the inception of coffee plantations in India) and Sumatra’s Finest Mandheling - Grade 1 - A non-fed, pre-civet, cruelty free version of the favourite Kopi-Luwak (which was earlier, predominantly force fed to civets) The brand’s key differentiation is their plantation-based sourcing of coffee beans, which are pre-deemed ‘specialty grade’ by the coffee board and other dignitaries in India. Home Blend was also amongst the first brands to introduce the equipment-free, convenient pour-over concept of Drip Coffee Bags in the country. Drip Coffee Bags contain freshly roasted, specialty grade grounds that brew a perfect cup of coffee without any costly equipment or unnecessary hassle. name: Ikkis Coffee Roasters
about_blurb: IKKIS Coffee Roasters exists at the intersection of craft, culture, and quiet precision. We believe coffee is not just consumed — it is remembered, repeated, and slowly understood. Every decision we make, from sourcing to roasting to design, is guided by a single question:does this deepen the ritual, or distract from it? Coffee today is loud — louder packaging, louder claims, louder timelines. IKKIS was built as a counterpoint.

name: KUP Coffee Roasters, Nungambakkam
tagline: क for KUP
about_blurb: KUP is a Chennai-based modern coffee bar and kitchen rooted in desi culture and community, positioned as a vibrant happy place to linger, unwind, and savour life. Operating out of Nungambakkam, they blend a specialty coffee focus with an Indian sensibility, welcoming guests from morning through the late hours. Their ethos goes beyond the transactional, prioritising atmosphere, connection, and a sense of belonging over a great cup.

name: Kafeido Roastery
tagline: Kafeido is a speciality coffee roastery located in Gurgaon. We source only the highest quality, ethically-grown coffee beans and freshly roast them to order.

name: Kallucoppa Coffee Pvt Ltd Factory
tagline: Kallucoppa Coorg Coffee | Shipped directly from Coffee plantations in Coorg | Freshly roasted to order | Order Online
about_blurb: Our heritage is everything. From who we are to what we do to where we do it, comes in a nice little package, passed down from generation to generation right through our ancestry. The natural history we share with the land we call Kodagu and we are part of the Kodava community. Ancient wisdom on how to live off the land and to sustainably harvest its bounty has been part and parcel of our culture. The pioneer of the Kallucoppa coffee estate was Mr. K G Aiyanna, who established this plantation in 1919. In the successive years the estate was looked after and expanded by his son Mr. K A Kuttaiah. Keeping to traditional principles, the coffee is intercropped with pepper, spices and other fruits giving it its unique flavour. The natural heritage is proof of the richness of this culture, with the sheer variety of trees, birds and insects found across our pristine estates. It is this same heritage that has taught us the art of making coffee, juices, wines and jams, of bringing the best out of every produce.

name: Kapi Kottai
tagline: Traceable coffee, artisanally roasted, sourced directly from farms.
about_blurb: Kāpikottai — meaning 'coffee beans' in Tamil — is a Chennai-based specialty roaster founded in late 2018 to champion traceable, sustainably grown Indian coffees through direct and empathetic relationships with farm partners. Their coffees are artisanally roasted by a Carnatic musician, and many blends are named after Carnatic ragas, weaving music and terroir into a unique sensory experience. The brand advocates for traceability, social equity, and low environmental impact across the Indian coffee supply chain.

name: Kapiberry Beverages - Artisan Coffee Roastery and Gourmet Coffee Bean
tagline: We  started Kapiberry Beverages with a passion for Coffee. We source from the best coffee estates , Roast it with passion and pack it with care for a best brewing experience.
about_blurb: Kapiberry Beverages is a Kochi-based artisan coffee roastery that sources, roasts, and packs premium single-origin and blended Indian coffees in small batches to ensure freshness and quality. Operating on a quality-over-quantity philosophy, they offer a range of light, medium, and dark roasts alongside café premixes, catering to diverse brewing methods. Their commitment to transparency and sustainability supports local Indian coffee growers across the country's diverse coffee-growing regions.
roast_focus: Light to dark, multiple roast levels

name: Kapiberry Coffee Academy- Training Barista of Tomorrow
tagline: We  started Kapiberry Beverages with a passion for Coffee. We source from the best coffee estates , Roast it with passion and pack it with care for a best brewing experience.
about_blurb: Kapiberry Coffee Academy is the barista training arm of Kapiberry Beverages, based in Kochi, Kerala, dedicated to crafting the baristas of tomorrow. The academy offers professional coffee education and hands-on training programs designed to equip aspiring baristas and coffee professionals with industry-ready skills. It operates as a dedicated wing focused on elevating coffee craft and expertise across India.

name: Kat & Kin Coffee Roasters
tagline: With immense gratitude to you, from our family to yours.
about_blurb: Kat & Kin Coffee Roasters is a family-owned Chennai specialty roastery founded in 2020 during the global lockdown, born from a personal quest to discover exceptional coffee. Head roaster Kathryn began roasting from home before opening a dedicated roastery, offering a range from Indian origins like Monsooned Malabar and Kodai Reserve to international single-origins from Ethiopia, Costa Rica, and Kenya. The brand is built on a seed-to-cup philosophy and deep gratitude toward every link in the coffee chain.

name: Kkai cup coffee powder
tagline: The idea of Kkai Cup was born on July 30, 2024, amidst the beauty and resilience of Wayanad Coffee after the landslide shook our hills.
about_blurb: The idea of Kkai Cup was born on July 30, 2024, when the Wayanad landslide shook not only our hills but also our hearts. From that tragedy arose a purpose: to uplift local farmers through the art of coffee. We carefully source, passionately roast, and honor every bean. Each cup is a symbol of resilience, deeply rooted in Wayanad, crafted to inspire, rebuild, and deliver the best Wayanad’s coffee we don’t just make coffee , we rebuild hope. Born from the heartache of the Wayanad landslide on July 30, 2024, our mission is rooted in resilience. Every bean we roast comes from the hands of local farmers who stood strong through loss and change. We choose only the best, roast in small batches, and craft each cup with care We meticulously source the finest coffee beans from around the globe. From the farm to your cup.

name: Korebi Gourmet HQ
tagline: Korebi was created to make artisan coffee accessible for everyone. We aim to bring the best directly from the farm to your cup.
about_blurb: Korebi Coffee Roasters is founded by Nisarg Shah, an avid coffee connoisseur, in 2016. His journey into the world of coffee began whilst studying as a finance major, ironically coffee being a constant companion during that time he decided to dabble a bit further into it. Partly in search for better coffee than the one available around campus. His interest in brewing methods was also boosted through his flatmates at the time, who were South Indian Filter Coffee enthusiasts. He eventually started procuring green beans and roasted them with a local roaster on own. What started out as a pursuit for better coffee and sharing it with others at college has turned into what Korebi Coffee Roasters is today.

name: Korero Coffee Roasters Private Limited
about_blurb: Korero Coffee Roasters is an Indian specialty coffee roaster offering a curated lineup of single-origin and blended coffees sourced from notable Indian growing regions including Koraput, Valparai, and Heggadde. Their thoughtfully named offerings — including Anthology, Flower Ferry, Middle Son, Gravity, and 90s Child — reflect a storytelling-driven approach to specialty coffee.

Kruti Coffee started it's specialty coffee journey by transforming farm management practices of Kindiriguda tribal coffee farms in the Eastern Indian State of Odisha. Based out of London over the last two decades, Ms. Mona has a proven track record in the Global beauty and perfumery industry.

name: La Cuppa Coffee
about_blurb: For most people, a day begins with coffee. And everyone has a unique way they want their coffee, unique in many ways. There are different blends, flavors, roasting, brewing methods and so on, with and without milk, sugar. When the choices are so many, packaged coffee on the shelves limits the choice to a few variants. Moreover, by the time the coffee from the large roasteries comes to the shelves the coffee is already becoming stale where most of the amazing flavors of freshly roasted coffee are lost. . At La Cuppa Coffee we have one simple mission in mind – to bring great tasting, freshly-roasted coffee to Coffee Lovers. To deliver this goal, we source coffee from some select coffee farms in South India, roast them in our small batch roastery in Coimbatore. We believe in sourcing coffee responsibly in regard to the environment and farming communities. We work closely with the coffee farms with whom we have direct relationships.

name: Libertario Coffee Roasters India
tagline: born in colombia, crafted for the world
about_blurb: Libertario Coffee Roasters India is a Colombian-born specialty coffee brand that brings its 20-year legacy of purpose-driven brewing to the Indian market. Rooted in the coffee culture of Bogotá and Medellín, the brand is celebrated for its Geisha beans and signature blends — Paz, Libre, and Rock — each crafted for a distinct flavor journey. Their India operations, launched in 2025, combine Colombian artisanal expertise with brewing customization tailored to Indian sensibilities.

name: Love Kaapi | Best Chikmagalur Coffee
tagline: Single-origin estate coffee from the hills of Chikmagalur.
about_blurb: Love Kaapi is an estate-to-cup specialty coffee brand delivering single-origin Arabica grown on their family estate in Javali, Chikmagalur, handpicked from the slopes of the Western Ghats. Founded by Supriya Nayak, Love Kaapi roasts to order in small batches, using Q-grader profiled roasts to highlight the character of their AA and AAA-grade beans. The brand celebrates South Indian filter coffee culture while offering B2B services including custom blends, barista training, and wholesale supply.
roast_focus: Fresh roasted to order, Q-grader profiled

name: Lush - The Café
tagline: Lush the Cafe, nestled in the vibrant neighborhood of Uzan bazaar, Guwahati has swiftly emerged as a leading dining destination since opening its doors in 2022.
about_blurb: Lush the Cafe, nestled in the vibrant neighborhood of Uzan bazaar, Guwahati, has swiftly emerged as a leading dining destination since opening its doors in 2022. With a focus on an innovative, experimental & vegetarian cuisine, the cafe redefines dining by blending sustainability with culinary artistry. With dishes crafted using locally sourced & gifted ingredients around the seven sisters, we strive to reflect a deep commitment to environmental stewardship and the promotion of healthy and conscious eating. Lush the Cafe is more than just a place to eat; it offers an immersive dining experience that celebrates the diverse and rich cultural heritage of Northeast India. The thoughtfully designed space, adorned with elements inspired by the region's natural beauty and traditions, provides a warm and inviting atmosphere that resonates with both locals and visitors alike. Beyond its culinary offerings, Lush the Cafe stands as a cornerstone for community engagement. It regularly hosts events, workshops, and collaborations that support local artists, entrepreneurs, and environmental initiatives, reinforcing its role as a hub for creativity and social impact. By integrating sustainable practices with a deep appreciation for local culture, Lush the Cafe not only delights the palate but also inspires a greater connection to the community and the environment.

name: Mary Lodge by Subko
tagline: From the Subcontinent, For All.
about_blurb: Mary Lodge by Subko is the flagship café and roastery of Subko Specialty Coffee Roasters, housed in a lovingly restored 1925 Goan bungalow in Bandra West, Mumbai. Opened in March 2020, the expanded Mary Lodge 2.0 offers a spacious, design-forward space serving specialty coffee, artisanal bread from the craft bakehouse, and fine cacao from across the Indian subcontinent. It embodies Subko's founding vision of showcasing subcontinental flavors through multi-species coffee, pod-to-bar cacao, and micro-batch baking.

name: Mirras Coffee India Private Limited
tagline: From the House of Asia's First Planter.
about_blurb: Mirras Coffee India Private Limited is a Coimbatore-based coffee manufacturer from the House of Asia's First Planter, a legacy tracing back over a century to pioneering plantations in Malaysia and Sri Lanka. With estates in Somwarpet, Karnataka, the company processes premium filter, instant, and flavoured coffees using German technology, commanding approximately 75% of institutional coffee supply in Tamil Nadu. Founded as a retail brand in 2018, Mirras offers products worldwide and has deep roots in Indian coffee growing heritage.

name: Nithara Coffee
tagline: From the Soul of Tamil Nadu: Filter Coffee that Captivates Your Senses.
about_blurb: Nithara Coffee is a Salem, Tamil Nadu-based specialty coffee brand founded in 2020, whose name means 'Deep Rooted' in Sanskrit — reflecting their commitment to quality, consistency, and service. The company handles every stage from bean cultivation and harvesting to curing, roasting, and blending, sourcing from award-winning estates across the southern hills of India. Their lineup spans premium filter coffee blends and instant coffee powders crafted for the South Indian palate.
roast_focus: Roast and ground filter coffee focus

name: Nothing Before Coffee Sapna Sangeeta
tagline: Great coffee. Honest price. Everyday rituals.
about_blurb: Nothing Before Coffee is a Jaipur-born coffee brand founded in 2017 by four coffee enthusiasts united by a simple question: why is great coffee either too expensive or too ordinary? The brand democratizes specialty coffee by delivering high quality at honest, accessible prices for everyday rituals. With a growing café presence, Nothing Before Coffee has built a loyal community around approachable, seasonal, and indulgent coffee experiences.

name: Okiru Coffee Roasters
tagline: Freshly roasted coffee with complete transparency
about_blurb: Okiru Coffee Roasters is a specialty roaster based in Zirakpur, Punjab, whose name means 'to wake up' in Japanese — a nod to their mission of awakening the senses through transparent, freshly roasted coffee. They source exceptional beans from India's finest estates, roast every batch in-house, and offer Sunday roasting workshops alongside a co-working café space.

name: PANDURANGA COFFEE 1938
tagline: Rich in history, rich in flavor
about_blurb: Founded in 1938 by Sri Papanna Setty in Chikmagalur, Panduranga Coffee Works is a five-generation family roastery that has grown from a small shop into one of South India's most heritage-rich coffee brands. Now managed by the third generation, they are known for traditional South Indian filter coffee blends and premium ground coffee sourced from high-altitude Chikmagalur plantations.

name: Pandhal Coffee & Brews
tagline: Pandhal, one of the best cake shops in Kochi, offers a wide range of cakes, pastries, and good food. Visit us today and experience one of the best cafes in Kochi.
about_blurb: Pandhal Cake Shop has been providing Kochi with premium quality cakes, pastries, savories, and more since 1984. Our dedication to quality ingredients and traditional recipes has made us one of the most beloved sweet destinations in the city.We strive to provide every customer with an enjoyable experience that will bring them back to us time and time again. Whether it’s for a special occasion or just a sweet treat, Pandhal Cake Shop is here to satisfy your sweet tooth.

name: Riverside Coffee - Estate Stay, Coorg
tagline: Farm to cup — coffee that never leaves our premises
about_blurb: Riverside Coffee is a single-estate roaster from Coorg, Karnataka, with a family heirloom farm dating back to 1898. They grow, process, and roast all their coffee on their own premises, offering specialty-grade Arabica and Robusta across multiple processing methods including washed, natural, honey, and experimental fermentations. The estate also welcomes visitors for an immersive farm-to-cup stay experience.

name: Roastery of Vui
tagline: Greetings from Mysuru. Vui is a collective of Producers, Workers, and Consumers of Coffee. The happiness of all three is our reason for existence.
about_blurb: Growing up in Chennai, life revolved around basketball and the urban outdoors. P.S. Senior School was tough, and often felt like a cage, yet the place set the academic bar so high that everything that followed felt easier. When I started four years of mechanical engineering at Hindustan College in Chennai, time was plentiful, and academic pressure non-existent, and I began exploring India. Soon I was catching a train out at any opportunity and grew comfortable in any situation in return forexperiencing something new. After a brief and unsuccessful stint as an engineer, I went to IIM Indore for an MBA. There I was trained in the methods of modern management, which was later put to use for a global commodity giant named Olam.

name: Rossette Coffee Lab | Roastery - Premium Specialty Coffee Roasters & Wholesalers in Delhi, India
tagline: We roast. We brew. We serve.
about_blurb: Rossette Coffee Lab is a Delhi-based specialty roastery founded in 2022 by Vansh Anand and Aashrray Singla, sourcing from 20+ estates across Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and Nagaland. They roast small batches in-house using a 5kg Probat roaster and are committed to fair trade and biodiverse farming, with all coffees scoring above 80 points on the SCA scale.

name: Saplings Cafe - Saplings Coffee Roasters
tagline: Order online from Saplings Coffee Roasters with secure payment options and seamless online shopping experience.
about_blurb: Saplings Coffee Roasters is an Indian specialty coffee business that offers high-quality, freshly roasted coffee beans. We provide a variety of unique blends and single-origin coffees sourced from recognized places across the country. Our expertise is carefully crafted blends that highlight the distinct flavors of Indian coffee, ensuring a rich and satisfying experience for coffee enthusiasts. Saplings Coffee Roasters aspires to provide customers with an exceptional coffee experience by emphasizing freshness and quality.Saplings Coffee Roasters does not negotiate prices with farmers, ensuring fair compensation for their produce. This approach fosters trust and long-term partnerships, allowing farmers to focus on quality cultivation without the pressure of price negotiations. By guaranteeing a fair price, Saplings Coffee Roasters supports sustainable farming practices and contributes to the well-being of the farming community.

name: Sardar-Ji-Bakhsh Coffee | Patliputra Colony, Patna
tagline: Sardar-Ji-Bakhsh Coffee & Co.
about_blurb: Coffee that feels familiar. Spaces that feel lived in. Behind Sardar-Ji-Bakhsh Coffee, is a way of thinking that values restraint, intention, and longevity. The brand evolves, but its core remains steady; thoughtful coffee, well-considered spaces, and decisions made with the timelessness in mind. We believe in an unrushed culture. In slowing down, brewing with care, and letting coffee be more than a moment in between. We create timeless spaces, built to be lived in, returned to, and felt over time. At the heart of it all is specialty coffee. Thoughtfully sourced, patiently brewed, and served with intention.

name: Savorworks Coffee Chocolate - GK2
about_blurb: Ever wonder why your coffee is served with a shot of soda?It’s not just for refreshment. Soda helps cleanse your palate, allowing your taste buds to better perceive the nuanced flavors and aromas. But the artistry of specialty coffee and chocolate goes beyond taste. It’s an intricate blend of science, craftsmanship, and dedication. Ready to uncover their stories? Let’s begin 1. What Is Specialty Coffee and How Is It Different from Average Coffee?Specialty coffee refers to beans that are carefully cultivated, processed, and scored 80 or above on a 100-point scale based on flavor, aroma, and overall quality. Unlike regular or mass-market coffee, which often has inconsistent flavor or defects, specialty coffee emphasizes excellence, uniqueness, and superior craftsmanship. While Arabica is a popular variety, it does not automatically make coffee specialty; the distinction lies in quality, handling, and origin. Specialty coffee involves meticulous attention from farm to cup, ensuring a richer and more consistent experience.

name: Select by Kruti Coffee
about_blurb: Kruti Coffee was founded in 2013 to support tribal coffee growers in Koraput, Odisha, and has grown into one of India's fastest-growing specialty coffee brands. Their signature forest coffees are sourced directly from 40 tribal families in Kindiriguda village at 3,000 ft altitude, with fair-trade principles at their core — a mission that earned their Kindiriguda Naturals the 'Fine Cup Award 2023' as India's No. 1 Arabica Naturals.

name: Shot In The Dark Coffee Boutique @ Crest
tagline: India's first coffee curation boutique
about_blurb: Shot In The Dark is India's first online coffee boutique, based in Gurugram, curating exceptional coffees from roasters across the country. The boutique stocks all formats — whole beans, ground coffee, instant, liquid coffee, and Nespresso capsules — each selected for craftsmanship and character, and also serves major cafés, restaurants, and hotels across India.

name: Shot In The Dark Coffee Curation Company
tagline: India's only coffee curation company
about_blurb: Shot In The Dark Coffee Curation Company is India's pioneering coffee curation platform based in Gurugram, supplying specialty coffee to cafés, restaurants, and hotels nationwide. They curate beans, ground coffee, instant brews, liquid coffee, and Nespresso capsules from roasters across India, making them one of the fastest-growing coffee curators in the country's hospitality sector.

name: Silk Road Coffee Company Experience Center
tagline: Big Bean Energy.
about_blurb: Silk Road Coffee Company is a Mumbai-based specialty roaster founded in 2021 by Parth Suri and Shamit Tyagi, a collective of artists and creatives united by a passion for coffee. Operating from Versova, Mumbai, they source Arabica beans from India's renowned coffee estates and specialize in innovative processing methods including carbonic maceration and anaerobic natural.

name: Siolim Specialty Coffee Roasters Indore
about_blurb: Siolim Coffee Roasters is my top choice for coffee in India. Their diverse range of offerings, partnerships with estate growers, and curated selections are outstanding. From my very first order, I was hooked and haven't looked back since. As a home brewer, I love discovering new roasters, and Siolim stands out with their unique offerings. My favorite is the Lobo P1. What sets Siolim apart is their humility and openness to feedback. I’ve seen their quality improve with every launch, which is rare in the market. Their packaging also scores a perfect 10/10, making it great for gifting. Keep it up, team! Excellent anaerobic fermented light medium roasted coffee with the aroma of Floral and spices, flavors of Cardamom, clove and  bakers chocolate. medium acidity and medium body. very well balanced cup.

name: Sri Narasu's Coffee Company Limited -Coimbatore Main
about_blurb:
Narasu's has been a symbol of tradition, trust, and quality. From humble beginnings to a
                beloved
                household name, it's built a legacy through ethics, reliability, and integrity. With authentic taste and
                rich aroma, Narasu celebrates heritage and the timeless joy of coffee that brings people together across
                generations We believe great coffee begins with responsibility. We're committed to ethical sourcing, fair
                        trade practices, and supporting the farmers who make every cup possible. Through sustainable
                        production and community initiatives, we empower livelihoods, reduce environmental impact, and
                        uplift local communities. Every effort reflects our promise: to give back with integrity,
                        compassion, and purpose for people and the planet. Narasu's Coffee combines tradition with modern standards at every step,
                    from sourcing and roasting to grinding and packaging. Our operations across Tamil Nadu ensure rich
                    aroma, consistent taste, and hygienic processing in every blend. Working with experienced teams and
                    trusted partners, we maintain quality and reliable distribution to retail outlets, online platforms,
                    and markets nationwide. This integrated approach delivers the authentic Narasu's experience to
                    coffee lovers everywhere.

name: Takaraa Specialty Coffees
tagline: Takaraa Specialty Coffee
about_blurb: Why does the world celebrate Colombian beans, Ethiopian origins, and Jamaican Blue Mountain—but overlook India? India has been growing coffee for over 400 years. Our estates span the Western Ghats, one of the world's biodiversity hotspots. Our farmers cultivate beans at elevations that rival the finest coffee regions globally. Our terroir produces flavor profiles as complex as any wine region in Burgundy. Yet when global roasters, café owners, and coffee enthusiasts think "specialty coffee," India rarely comes to mind.

name: The Bean Co Roasters
tagline: Premium Roasted Arabica & Robusta Coffee Beans
about_blurb: A Brand That Started with a Question: ‘Can Coffee Be Better?’ The story of The Bean Co Roasters began long before it became a coffee label. It started as a quiet fascination—one that grew stronger with every cup, every aroma and every new origin explored. For Amandeep Singh Agand (Founder – The Bean Co Roasters), coffee was never just a drink; it was a craft waiting to be understood. Over time, that curiosity matured into a vision: to build a brand that respected the journey of the bean and shared that journey with everyday coffee lovers. What makes The Bean Co unique is its approach to coffee—not as a trend, not as a commodity, but as a story that begins at the farm and ends in someone’s favourite mug. Amandeep believed that a good cup is the result of intention and care at every step. This belief shaped the brand’s identity from day one.

name: The Cacao Mill by Subko
tagline: Bringing Fine Cacao To The Forefront
about_blurb: The Cacao Mill by Subko is a purpose-driven, design-led fine cacao brand reshaping the cacao landscape within the Indian subcontinent with a 'Pod-to-Bar' philosophy. They source single-origin cacao from Kerala, Karnataka, and Andhra Pradesh, crafting Terroir Bars, Filled Bars, Experimental Bars, and more. Part of the Subko family — known for specialty coffee — the Cacao Mill brings the same quality-first ethos to Indian fine chocolate.

name: The Cocoa Bean Chocolate factory kodaikanal
tagline: The Cocoa Bean
about_blurb: The Cocoa Bean Chocolatier is a beloved artisanal chocolate house founded in 2010 in the misty hills of Kodaikanal, Tamil Nadu. They craft handmade chocolates — from truffles and fudges to center-filled and roasted-nut varieties — using high-cocoa Belgian chocolate and premium ingredients. Their homemade, small-batch approach has made them a go-to destination for indulgent gifting across India.

name: The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf
tagline: Buy exceptional coffee, tea, powders, equipment and drinkware at The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf® online store to enjoy our globally sourced products at home.
about_blurb: Download The Coffee Bean® Rewards app and enjoy member perks and exclusive offers today! Let your taste travel with every cup. Featuring our new Protein Lattes. Enjoy your favorite The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf drink in one of our local cafes or order supplies to make at home.

name: Toise Coffee Roastery + Brewstudio
tagline: Slow and steady always savours the day
about_blurb: Toise is a specialty coffee roastery and café in Worli, Mumbai, founded by a Q Grader who discovered specialty coffee during his MBA in Boston and trained at Boot Campus under industry mentors Valerian and Willem. The brand takes its name from the tortoise in Aesop's fable, embodying a philosophy of slow, mindful coffee appreciation, and roasts on India's only 12kg electric roaster.

name: Vismitha Coffee
about_blurb: Vismitha Coffee is an Indian coffee brand with roots in a working coffee estate, offering freshly sourced and processed coffee to consumers across the country. Their website is primarily JavaScript-rendered and detailed content could not be extracted. Based on available signals, they represent a farm-to-cup philosophy connecting consumers directly to estate-grown Indian coffee.

name: Vismitha Coffee Estate tour and coffee experience center
about_blurb: Vismitha Coffee Estate Tour offers visitors an immersive experience on a working Indian coffee plantation, where guests can witness the full journey of coffee from plant to cup. The estate experience is designed to educate and delight coffee enthusiasts through guided tours of cultivation and processing. As the experiential arm of Vismitha Coffee, it bridges the gap between grower and consumer through direct engagement.

name: WEST MOUNT COFFEE PROCESSING FACTORY
tagline: Coffee Roastery, Coffee Dry Mill
about_blurb: West Mount Coffee is an artisan roaster based in Wayanad's Chundale, near the Indian Coffee Board Research Centre in the Western Ghats. They are committed to small-batch, handcrafted roasting with a focus on ethically and sustainably sourced beans, offering five distinct flavor profiles — Arabica Pure, Bold, Wild, Houseblend, and Brew. Beyond retail coffee, they also offer professional barista equipment and online coffee mastery courses.

name: WonderBean Coffee Co
about_blurb: Wonderbean began with a simple belief—that Indian coffee, when treated with care and respect, can speak for itself. Our journey started with sourcing coffee beans from thehigh-altitude estates of Chikkamagaluru. Surrounded by mist-covered hills, rich soil, and generations of coffee knowledge. Time spent at these estates taught us that great coffee is not about speed or scale. It is about patience, consistency, and respect for process. These lessons became the foundation on which Wonderbean was built.

name: World of Coffee Experience Cafe
tagline: Committed to bringing the best of Chikmagalur to your cup
about_blurb: World of Coffee is a legacy coffee enterprise from Chikmagalur, founded in 1952 by Mr. Srinivas Shetty, with over 80 years of coffee heritage rooted in a 150-acre estate. They operate India's first fully automatic roaster and claim the world's first 4D interactive café, making them pioneers in both production and coffee experiences. Their estate-grown specialty coffees — including honey-processed, barrel-aged, anaerobic, and single-origin robusta — are available across 8 retail outlets in Karnataka and shipped pan-India.
roast_focus: Precision-roasted, full spectrum from light to specialty

name: nada
tagline: Less but better — Nada celebrates mindful living, elevate everyday rituals through coffee, ceramics, and timeless design
about_blurb: Nada was born from a desire to revive the beauty of the everyday — to create objects and experiences that celebrate slowness, tactility, and connection. We work across coffee, ceramics, bread, and design to cultivate a sense of presence in a world of constant motion. Based in goa, india, we collaborate closely with artisans, growers, and makers to honour tradition while embracing thoughtful innovation. Whether you’re enjoying a cup of coffee at our tasting room or drinking from one of our handmade cups at home, you are part of the circle of care that guides all we do. ​From hand-thrown ceramic vessels to carefully roasted coffee and freshly baked bread, everything we create is grounded in a respect for materials and the rhythms of making. Our pieces are meant to be used, touched, and lived with — companions to daily rituals and quiet moments.
